page.layout: One page of text. Running head at top: "APPENDIX." with page number at top right. Below it, a full-width title in capitals, then a centred italic greeting, then one body paragraph with a large initial H, and a closing "Datum" at the lower right. No margin notes, no footnotes.

main_text.head: HONORABILI NOSTRO ET IMPERII SACRI FIDELI DILECTO, BILIBALDO PIRCKHEIMER, CONSILIARIO NOSTRO.

p.i: Maximilianus, Divina favente clementia, &c. Romanorum Imperator, semper augustus, &c.

main_text.p: HOnorabilis, fidelis, dilecte: Luciani commentarium de ratione conscribendae Historiae, perquam accuratè à te Latinitate donatum, una cum litteris tuis accepimus, opus sanè luculentum, propter quod Latini non parum lucubrationibus tuis debeant; & praecipuè hii, qui fortium virorum res, rem profecto arduam, monumentis scriptorum suorum posteritati mandant; quandoquidem tam celebrati Auctoris vestigiis innitentes, in lubrico solo pedem firmius ponere possunt. Iamque Nos, si quid perpetuitate dignum gerimus, sub Luciani tui leges, à summi ingenii viris descriptum, fidem apud posteros confecuturum non desperamus: idque totum vigiliis tuis adscribimus, & merito pro tanto beneficio te summa benevolentia complectimur, & omni officio prosequemur.

page.notes: The initial H is a large woodcut-style letter and is joined to "onorabilis" as "Honorabilis". The "ct" in "Auctoris" is a ligature in the print. The page number is read as 293. The page ends at "Datum"; the rest of the date line is not printed on this page.
